nodes.label: Framique Platform
nodes.description: Full-stack cloud hosting service provider for ecommerce storefronts. BDT-first, multi-tenant, with CMS, visual builder, zero-fee commerce engine, payments, courier dispatch, themes, analytics, AI support, and infrastructure.

attributes.rationale: Central project entity; all other nodes relate back to it.

nodes.label: Merchant Admin Module
nodes.description: The merchant admin console covering RBAC, identity, customers, staff approval, product options/variants, console UX, and route audit.

attributes.rationale: Aggregates all 02-merchant sub-specs into a single module.

nodes.label: RBAC System
nodes.description: Role-based access control with owner, manager, staff roles. Permission grants per resource (products, orders, themes, etc.). Enforced via Postgres RLS and RPC grants.

attributes.rationale: Core security subsystem referenced across all merchant and E2E specs.

nodes.label: Identity & Auth System
nodes.description: Merchant identity runtime covering GoTrue auth, session management, MFA, staff login, and tenant scoping.

attributes.rationale: Foundational auth layer; referenced by RBAC and staff approval.

nodes.label: Customers Module
nodes.description: Customer list, profiles, order history, tags, and export for merchant admins.

attributes.rationale: Core merchant-facing data entity.

nodes.label: Staff Approval Workflow
nodes.description: Owner-approval gate for new staff accounts. Invites, approval, rejection, and revocation flows.

attributes.rationale: Crosses RBAC, identity, and audit concerns.

nodes.label: Admin Backbone
nodes.description: Architectural foundation for the merchant admin console: layout, navigation, data loading patterns, and component structure.

attributes.rationale: Structural foundation for all console pages.

nodes.label: Options & Variants System
nodes.description: Product option types (size, color) and variant generation with matrix views, SKU creation, and inventory tracking.

attributes.rationale: Core product data model component.

nodes.label: Console UX Checklist
nodes.description: UX standards and checklist for the merchant admin console pages: layout, responsiveness, error states, loading states.

attributes.rationale: Quality gate for all console implementations.

nodes.label: Console Route Audit
nodes.description: Audit of all admin console routes: route definitions, auth guards, permission checks, and data loading.

attributes.rationale: Security and completeness audit for navigation surface.

nodes.label: Engineering Gates
nodes.description: Release quality gates: typecheck, unit tests, contract tests, schema check, E2E, Lighthouse a11y, performance, and security scans.

attributes.rationale: Cross-cutting quality enforcement referenced by AGENTS.md.

nodes.label: Admin Loop E2E
nodes.description: End-to-end test suite for the merchant admin console: login, navigation, CRUD operations, RBAC enforcement.

attributes.rationale: Primary admin console validation suite.

nodes.label: Owner Loop E2E
nodes.description: End-to-end test suite for owner-specific workflows: staff management, approval gates, billing, settings.

attributes.rationale: Validates owner-level RBAC and approval workflows.

nodes.label: Fraud Loop E2E
nodes.description: End-to-end test suite for fraud detection: risk scoring, order flags, manual review, chargeback handling.

attributes.rationale: Validates commerce security and risk subsystem.

nodes.label: Theme Registry
nodes.description: Theme install, switch, snapshot, publish, rollback, token overrides, and CDN purge. Includes fallback handling and widget validation. Maps to Tenant006 schema.

attributes.rationale: Crosses builder, storefront runtime, and E2E concerns.

nodes.label: AI Support Loop E2E
nodes.description: End-to-end test suite for AI-powered customer support: provenance chips, money/order/stock answers via server-pinned lookups, provider-down fallback to static FAQ, escalation with order ids.

attributes.rationale: Validates AI support integration with commerce data.

nodes.label: Marketplace Loop E2E
nodes.description: End-to-end test suite for the theme marketplace: listing lifecycle, review round-trips, install with rollback, 70/30 payout math, marketplace-down resilience.

attributes.rationale: Validates marketplace economics and theme distribution.

nodes.label: Theme Plan Bazaar
nodes.description: Amazon-class marketplace theme with 48 new + 9 upgraded widgets. AST v3 nesting, data-bound widget contract, responsive panel, demo import.

attributes.rationale: Defines the flagship theme composition and builder contract.

nodes.label: Design System
nodes.description: Framique design tokens: Facebook Blue + pink palette, typography scale, spacing, shadows, component variants. shadcn/ui New York style.

attributes.rationale: Visual language referenced by all UI specs.

nodes.label: Architecture
nodes.description: System architecture: Bun runtime, TanStack Start + Router + React Query, Tailwind CSS v4, Supabase (Postgres/RLS/GoTrue), Redis, Vite 8 + Nitro, OpenResty edge, Prometheus/Grafana/Loki/Sentry observability.

attributes.rationale: Foundational technical decisions affecting all modules.

nodes.label: Multi-Tenancy
nodes.description: Tenant isolation via RLS on every public table, explicit GRANTs per role, merchant-scoped data. Each merchant gets a storefront at store.framique.com/<slug>.

attributes.rationale: Core architectural constraint referenced across all modules.

nodes.label: Row-Level Security
nodes.description: Postgres RLS policies on every public table. No client-trusted decisions for price, discount, stock, tax, entitlement, risk, or role.

attributes.rationale: Security enforcement mechanism for multi-tenancy and RBAC.

nodes.label: E2E Testing Framework
nodes.description: Playwright-based E2E test suites: store_loop, admin_loop, builder_loop, market_loop, public_loop, failure_loop, owner_loop, currency_gate, fraud_loop, ai_support_loop, tenant_isolation.

attributes.rationale: Quality validation layer for all user-facing flows.

nodes.label: Money Rules
nodes.description: Integer minor units for money (amount_minor_int + currency_code). No floats stored, transmitted, or computed. Server-side only price/discount/tax resolution.

attributes.rationale: Non-negotiable financial data integrity rule.

Framique Platform
nodes.description: Full-stack cloud hosting service provider for Bangladesh — CMS, storefront builder, payments, courier dispatch, POS, AI support, fraud detection, and infrastructure.
nodes.confidence_reason: Explicitly defined in marketing copy and AGENTS.md as the core product.

nodes.label: Architecture
nodes.description: System topology: services, tenancy boundary, data flow, edge, security posture, observability contract. Shared Postgres with RLS-tenant isolation.

nodes.label: Tenancy Model
nodes.description: Shared-table multi-tenant isolation via merchant_id column + Postgres RLS policies. No per-tenant schemas. Every query scoped by JWT claim.
nodes.confidence_reason: Core architectural invariant defined in tenancy-runtime.md.

nodes.label: Storefront
nodes.description: Headless, theme-based storefront served at <merchant>.store.framique.com. Includes catalog, search, cart, checkout, customer accounts. Bangla-first.
nodes.confidence_reason: Explicitly defined as a core surface.

nodes.label: Marketplace
nodes.description: Two-sided marketplace: Side A (themes + plugins for install), Side B (merchant cross-tenant product listings). 70/30 vendor split, enterprise + KYC gate.
nodes.confidence_reason: Explicitly defined as a cross-tenant surface.

nodes.label: Fraud & Risk System
nodes.description: Server-side-only order fraud detection tuned to Bangladesh COD abuse. Rule engine with hard blocks, soft holds, auto-approve. 14 test cases.

nodes.label: AI Support
nodes.description: Advisory-only AI assistant for merchants and buyers. RAG over docs/KB, tool-pinned money/stock/order lookups, escalate-to-human after 2 unsure turns.

nodes.label: Visual Builder
nodes.description: Section-based storefront builder: drag sections, edit tokens, version, rollback. Same renderer for editor and live store. Five official themes.

nodes.label: Owner Console
nodes.description: Platform-owner surface at /root. Pricing drafts, gateway toggles, fraud desk, AI management, user/RBAC, compliance settings. Never owns record data.

nodes.label: Security
nodes.description: RLS tenancy isolation on every table, scoped API keys, payment data tokenisation, incident response runbook, vulnerability disclosure policy.
nodes.confidence_reason: Security page with 19 bands detailing mechanisms.

nodes.label: Postgres with RLS
nodes.description: Self-hosted Postgres with row-level security. Security-definer helper functions for membership/role checks. Every tenant table carries merchant_id.

nodes.label: Redis
nodes.description: Rate limiting (sorted-set sliding window), idempotency keys, caching (L1/L2), BullMQ workers, hot checkout session state.

nodes.label: Go Payments Gateway
nodes.description: Aggregator: MFS (bKash/Nagad/Rocket), bank, COD preauth. Idempotent charge/refund/payout. Webhook intake. Rate limiter.

nodes.label: OpenResty Edge
nodes.description: Edge TLS termination via lua-resty-acme, ACME auto-renewal, custom domain resolution, storefront caching, rate limiting.

nodes.label: TanStack Router
nodes.description: File-based routing for SPA. Routes in src/routes/. Shell patterns for public, admin, and owner surfaces.

nodes.label: Vite
nodes.description: Build tool with Nitro backend. Route-level code splitting, HMR, ESM-first. Builds for both SPA frontend and server.

nodes.label: Tailwind CSS v4
nodes.description: Styling with shadcn/ui (New York style). Design tokens: canvas, surfaces, ink, signal-blue accent, BD teal primary.

nodes.label: Supabase
nodes.description: Self-hosted: Postgres, GoTrue auth, Storage, PostgREST. Connection strings: SUPABASE_URL, SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY, SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY.

nodes.label: Observability Stack
nodes.description: Self-hosted: Prometheus (metrics), Grafana (dashboards), Loki/Promtail (logs), Sentry (errors), Alertmanager (alerts). 30-day retention.
nodes.confidence_reason: Stack explicitly listed in security page.

nodes.label: Five Official Themes
nodes.description: Classic (broad catalogue), Modern (visual brands), Landing (single product), Supershop (high-SKU grocery), B2B (wholesale). Each purpose-built.
nodes.confidence_reason: Explicitly named and described in home copy.

nodes.label: Bangla-First i18n
nodes.description: Bangla and English from one catalogue. bangla-display token: zero letter-spacing, 1.35+ line-height on lang="bn". BN/EN fields per product record.

nodes.label: BDT Integer Money
nodes.description: All money stored as currency_code + amount_minor_int (paisa). No floats. fmtBDT for display. Tabular numerals.
nodes.confidence_reason: Architecture rule: integer minor units for money.

nodes.label: MFS Payments (bKash/Nagad)
nodes.description: Core payment rails: bKash, Nagad, Rocket, Upay, Visa, Mastercard, COD. In-house aggregator behind idempotent charge/refund/payout contract.

nodes.label: Courier Integration
nodes.description: SteadFast, Pathao, RedX, Paperfly — multi-provider abstraction. Book pickups, print labels, track status inside order drawer.

nodes.label: Plugin System
nodes.description: Sandboxed worker sidecar runtime. Manifest-driven, scoped permissions, GDPR purge-on-uninstall. Events from closed enum.

nodes.label: Fraud Rule Engine
nodes.description: Pure/isomorphic determinist engine. Precedence-ordered rules: BLACKLIST_MATCH, HONEYPOT_TRIP (blocks) → BOT_BEACON through COD_MAX_AMOUNT (reviews).

nodes.label: Platform Governance
nodes.description: ownerGate wraps every owner operation: requirePlatformAdmin, rate-limit bucket, span+counter, append-only audit. 4-eyes for destructive ops.

nodes.label: Custom Domains
nodes.description: One custom hostname per tenant: TXT-record ownership proof, ACME TLS, automatic fallback to platform subdomain. Edge-resolved, not runtime-resolved.

nodes.label: Developer API Docs
nodes.description: REST API with scoped keys, cursor pagination, idempotent writes, signed webhooks. v1 stable, v0 archived. Sandbox Try It panel.

nodes.label: Home Page Copy
nodes.description: Marketing copy for /. Hero, rails marquee, product tour (6 rows), themes showcase, numbers, comparison, COD economics, pricing, stories, FAQ.

nodes.label: About Page Copy
nodes.description: Brand narrative + origin thesis. 8 operating principles, engineering philosophy, design philosophy, prioritization framework, commitments.

nodes.label: Builder Page Copy
nodes.description: Visual builder marketing copy. Section-based editing, tokens, versioning, themes, Bangla+English catalogue, custom fonts, performance budgets.

nodes.label: Security Page Copy
nodes.description: Security mechanisms page. 19 bands: tenancy isolation, auth, roles, API keys, secrets, payment tokenisation, encryption, backups, incidents.

nodes.label: Docs Landing Page
nodes.description: Developer docs landing. Quickstart, auth, endpoints, idempotency, pagination, rate limits, errors, webhooks, sandbox, SDKs, recipes.

nodes.label: Marketplace Listing Lifecycle
nodes.description: draft → in-review → listed → deprecated/removed. Append-only review chain. Four-eyes marketplace-operator persona, no self-approval.

nodes.label: Theme Vault
nodes.description: Content-addressed, immutable source vault. sha256 over manifest+AST+tokens+asset hashes. Never mutated after creation.

nodes.label: Checkout State Machine
nodes.description: cart → checkout → payment_selected → payment_pending → confirmed/paid (cancelled on abandon). Resumable via Redis+DB persistence.

nodes.label: Rate Limiting
nodes.description: Two-tier: Redis sorted-set sliding window (Tier 1) + Postgres fixed-window (Tier 2 fallback). Buckets: auth.signin, webhook.gateway, storefront.form, etc.

nodes.label: Caching System
nodes.description: L1 per-isolate TTL map + L2 shared Redis cache. Stale-while-revalidate, single-flight. Key must contain merchant_id for tenant data.

nodes.label: Marketplace Events
nodes.description: listing.created, listing.submitted, listing.reviewed, listing.listed, listing.deprecated, listing.removed, install.started/applied/failed/rollback/uninstalled.

nodes.label: Fraud Signals
nodes.description: Four families: checkout (device fingerprint, IP reputation, phone-format), payment (MFS velocity, amount vs historical, coupon stacking, COD abuse), identity (mismatch, first-order), external (chargeback rate, ad_bot_score).
nodes.confidence_reason: Signals explicitly registered in rule engine spec.

nodes.label: Impersonation Grants
nodes.description: Consented impersonation: pending_consent → active → expired|revoked. Tenant admin must approve. 5-240 min expiry. Every use logged with audit.

nodes.label: Rollback Mechanism
nodes.description: Installs are pins to exact version/content hash. Failed install reverts to previous pin. Marketplace-down = installs unavailable, storefronts keep running.

nodes.label: Idempotency Pattern
nodes.description: Idempotency keys on all non-GET requests. Redis-stored results for 24h. Prevents double-charge, double-note, double-export on retries.
nodes.confidence_reason: Idempotency explicitly documented in API docs.

nodes.label: Fraud Hard Blocks
nodes.description: Blacklist IP/phone/MFS account → deny + notify. Minimum 2 signals required. Short-circuits evaluation — blacklisted context never leaks other signals.

nodes.label: Fraud Soft Holds
nodes.description: Review queue entry with reason chips. Default risk is review — nothing auto-approves. Hold expires back to review after bounded window.

nodes.label: RAG Retrieval
nodes.description: Bengali-capable ONNX embeddings, docs+FAQ index. Retrieval on merchant/buyer question. Corpora merchant-scoped. Vector store host is swappable.

nodes.label: Consent Model
nodes.description: GDPR-grade consent flags. Opt-in OFF default. Channel toggles honor consent. No PII in training corpora. Transcript deletion honored.

nodes.label: Secrets Handling
nodes.description: Secrets never in error messages, Sentry bodies, metric labels, or URL query strings. scrubPayload/scrubText on every log line before leaving process.

nodes.label: Data Export
nodes.description: Full-account export (orders, customers, products, inventory, ledger) triggerable from settings. CSV or API. No support ticket required.

nodes.label: Tenant Hard Delete
nodes.description: GDPR-grade purge: request → suspend → cooling window (7d default, 0-90 clamp) → execute (platform admin only). Row counts stored on request.

nodes.label: Soft Delete
nodes.description: deleted_at timestamptz on product/catalog entities. Partial index on (merchant_id) where deleted_at is null. Money/history rows never soft-deleted.

nodes.label: Schema Fingerprinting
nodes.description: public.schema_fingerprint() returns table column counts, RLS flags, policy counts, function names, enum labels. CI gate: non-zero exit on drift.

nodes.label: Soft Delete Pattern
nodes.description: deleted_at timestamptz on products, categories, brands, collections, coupons, articles, media, segments, campaigns, customers, forms, carriers, fraud_rules.
nodes.confidence_reason: Soft delete explicitly implemented with partial indexes.

nodes.label: Tenant Purge
nodes.description: GDPR-grade hard delete: request → merchant.status=suspended → cooling window (7d default, 0-90 clamp) → platform-admin execute → FK cascade → row_counts stored.

nodes.label: Storefront Search
nodes.description: Postgres tsvector with GIN index + trigram GIN for partial matching. RPC-based: storefront_search handles all filtering/sorting/paging. Rate limit 90/min.

nodes.label: Shopper Accounts
nodes.description: OTP email/SMS + password auth. Address book, orders, reorder, wishlist. Security-definer routine for order detail access.

nodes.label: Product Reviews
nodes.description: 1-5 star PDP reviews. Verified-purchase gate, moderation queue, merchant reply, server-side aggregation (mean, count, histogram). Once per order per customer.

nodes.label: COD Economics
nodes.description: Cash-on-delivery return rate analysis. 18% return rate = ~1/3 gross profit consumed. Three levers: phone verification, fraud scoring, partial prepayment.
nodes.confidence_reason: COD economics worked example explicitly provided.

nodes.label: Pricing Framework
nodes.description: Four weighted criteria: structural fit (35%), reach (25%), reversibility risk (20%), time-to-merchant-value (20%). Public scoring mechanism.

nodes.label: Operating Principles
nodes.description: 8 principles: Ship what's true, Merchant owns data, Local first, Boring where it counts, Bangla not translation, Cash is payment method, Observability is product, No lock-in.
nodes.confidence_reason: Principles explicitly listed with forbidden behaviours.

nodes.label: Tenancy Isolation Invariant
nodes.description: Every tenant table carries merchant_id + RLS. RLS off or zero policies = leak. Storefront-public tables are explicit allow-list in leak suite.

nodes.label: Edge Cache TTL
nodes.description: 60s edge cache on storefront HTML. Cached HTML serves if runtime/API blips. Fallback template with maintenance notice on theme crash.

nodes.label: Storefront Failure Recovery
nodes.description: Edge down → cached HTML; runtime crash → fallback template; payment MFS timeout → 'Payment processing' + status poll. Idempotency for cart writes.

nodes.label: E2E Testing
nodes.description: store_loop (critical gate), admin_loop, builder_loop, market_loop, fraud_loop, owner_loop. Contract-first: suites are acceptance contracts.
nodes.confidence_reason: E2E suites explicitly listed in AGENTS.md.

nodes.label: Manifest Version Pinning
nodes.description: Installs are pins to exact (listing_id, package_id, version_pin). No 'install latest' — storefront upgrade is a deliberate new pin.

nodes.label: Listing Review Chain
nodes.description: Append-only review chain: marketplace.operator persona, no self-approval (hard server-side error), review_round increments on each submission.

nodes.label: Plugin Purge Machine
nodes.description: installed → uninstalling → enqueue_purge → purge_running → purge_complete|purge_failed. GDPR-aware erasure with idempotent queue.

nodes.label: Plugin Sandbox
nodes.description: Worker sidecar: per-tenant container, OS-level sandbox, bounded CPU/memory/egress. Network only to declared vendor endpoints + platform pipeline.

nodes.label: Worker Sidecar Runtime
nodes.description: One declared runtime: worker sidecar. Plugins never execute in storefront/checkout/builder JS contexts. Blast radius bounded.

nodes.label: Plugin Event Surface
nodes.description: Closed enum: storefront.pin_published, checkout.order_placed, cart.cart_updated, marketing.consent_updated, payment.paid, analytics.etl.batch_completed.

nodes.label: Owner Gate
nodes.description: ownerGate wraps every operation: requirePlatformAdmin + dedicated rate-limit bucket + span/counter + append-only audit. Audit failure = operation failure.

nodes.label: Merchant Suspension
nodes.description: merchant_suspensions holds full history. Suspending sets status=suspended + payments_frozen. assertPaymentsNotFrozen called from charge/refund paths.

nodes.label: Revenue Calculation
nodes.description: MRR sums plan prices in integer minor units. past_due counts (contract live). trial/paused/cancelled do not. Foreign-currency reported never converted.
nodes.confidence_reason: Revenue math explicitly defined with 11 test cases.

nodes.label: Revenue-Merchant Alignment
nodes.description: Revenue tracks merchant sales volume, not feature count. Self-hosting and data export are commitments that keep subscription business honest.
nodes.confidence_reason: Alignment explicitly argued in about page.

nodes.label: Framique
nodes.description: Next-generation SaaS Cloud CMS, visual storefront builder, and zero-transaction-fee commerce platform by devrahmanbd. Combines freeform visual canvas with native commerce engine.

nodes.label: Shopify
